paite: Pathian aw, na min in hon hondam inla, na hatna in vai hon hawmsak in.
heading: Ziph Mite Saul Kiang A Hoh A, Agamsung Ua David Kibu Ahi Chih Ahilh Lai Ua. David La / Melmate A Kipan A Humbitna Ngen A Thumna
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Isn’t David hiding himself among us?” Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.

paite: Pathian aw, ka thumna ngaikhia inla; ka kam a thu suakkhete bildoh in.
english: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.

paite: Mikhualte'n hon sual ua, mingongtatte'n ka hinna hihmang tum in azong ua, ama uah Pathian akoih kei uhi. Selah
english: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.

paite: Ngai in, Pathian hon panpihpa ahi a, TOUPA ka hinna lentu ahi.
english: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

paite: Ama'n ka melmate gitlouhna athuk ding a, nang amaute na thutakna ziak in hihmangthang in.
english: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

paite: Keimah deih thu a thil lan in na kiang ah ka kithoih ding a; TOUPA aw, na min ka phat ding, ahoih ziak in.
english: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, Yahweh, for it is good.

paite: Ka mangbatna tengteng ah na hon tankheta a; hon doute tung a ka deihtel ka mit in amuta hi.
english: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
